name: Chinese Auction
summary: Raffle-style all-pay auction where winning chance is proportional to amount bid.
rules_text: Each player has a private valuation for a single prize. Simultaneously, each player chooses a bid representing money spent or number of lottery tickets purchased at a fixed price. All bids are paid to the auctioneer regardless of outcome and are revealed. The winner is then drawn at random, with each player's probability of winning equal to his bid divided by the sum of all bids. If all bids are zero, no one wins. The winner receives the prize valued at his private valuation, so his payoff is valuation minus bid; losers payoff is minus their bid. The game models patent races and elections.
rating_reason: Specific all-pay raffle auction with proportional win chance
reasons: capability: needs something the manifest has no word for: proportional lottery winner selection
